data.description: Enjoy a family-centric community lifestyle in Arjan, Dubailand.

data.answer:
Arjan offers a serene environment. The buildings reflect contemporary styles and provide comfortable and aesthetically pleasing living spaces. It is a freehold area in Dubai with various residential options, including apartments and villas catering to different preferences and budgets.

Residents of Arjan enjoy access to numerous facilities that enhance their quality of life. The community is home to well-maintained parks and green spaces. In addition to recreational facilities, Arjan boasts a range of retail outlets, cafes, and restaurants, ensuring residents have convenient access to shopping and dining options.

The Arjan district in Dubailand features several residential sub-communities, including Lincoln Park, Green Diamond, Vincitore Palacio, Siraj Tower, and Platinum One. These areas offer a variety of new apartments available for rent.

For those seeking commercial properties, Arjan Dubailand has numerous offices and retail shops. Some of the most popular locations in Arjan include Lincoln Park, Platinum One, The Wings, Orion Building, and Skyz by Danube.

Off-Plan Properties in Arjan

Arjan, a rapidly developing neighborhood in Dubai, offers a variety of off-plan properties, making it an attractive option for investors and homebuyers. Notable projects include:

  • 48 Parkside by Tabeer Development, a 10-storey luxury apartment complex featuring contemporary one and two-bedroom units, set for completion in 2025. 
  • Avelon Boulevard by Avelon Real Estate Development offers studios, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments, expected to be completed in 2026. 
  • NAS 3 by Rabdan Developments is a 15-floor complex with elegant apartments, completing in 2024.
  • Torino by Oro24 Real Estate Developments features six-storey buildings with 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, ready by 2025. 
  • Mykonos Signature by Samana Developers epitomizes luxury with its 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, completing in 2025. 
  • Kyoto by Oro24, a 40-storey premium project, offers 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, also set for 2025.
  • Elano, another Oro24 project, features 1 and 2-bedroom apartments and its completion is expected in 2026. 
  • Marquis Insignia and Elegance by Marquis offer luxurious 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, with completion dates in 2025 and 2024, respectively. 
  • Beverly Boulevard by HMB Homes is a modern eight-floor complex with 1 and 2-bedroom units, ready in 2026.
  • Empire Estates by Empire Developments, offering apartments and townhouses, is set for 2026. 
  • Arbor View by Ellington Properties, a nine-story complex with 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, completes in 2026. 
  • Trinity by Deca Properties, a 15-floor luxury project, is scheduled for 2026.
  • Siraj Tower by Al Madar, featuring Spanish and Roman architecture, offers 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, ready by 2026. 
  • Samana Skyros by Samana Developers offers studios and 1 to 2-bedroom apartments with lush tropical features.

Buying a Property in Arjan

Searching for properties for sale in Arjan? Studio apartments in the area are available for AED 575k, while the price of 1-bedroom apartments for sale in Arjan might be around AED 1M. For 2-bedroom apartments, you might have to pay at least AED 1.08M.

Rental Properties in Arjan

You can also find various rental properties in Arjan. The rental prices for studio apartments start at AED 45,000, while a 1-bedroom apartment in Arjan is available for AED 55,000 annually. 2-bedroom apartments in the neighborhood are priced at AED 89,000, and 3-bedroom apartments begin at AED 90,000.

Life in Arjan offers a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty. The community is known for its serene environment, featuring well-maintained parks, green spaces, and family-friendly amenities.

Residents enjoy a range of recreational activities with attractions like the Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden nearby. The neighborhood is also equipped with various retail outlets, cafes, and restaurants, ensuring a convenient and vibrant lifestyle. Educational institutions and healthcare facilities within the area add to its appeal, making Arjan a desirable place for families and professionals alike.

Public Transportation in Arjan

Public transportation in Arjan is convenient, with several bus routes serving the area. The nearest metro station, Mall of the Emirates Metro Station, is approximately a 15-minute drive from Arjan, providing easy access to the broader Dubai Metro network.

Taxis and ride-sharing services are readily available, offering additional flexibility for residents. The well-developed road network ensures smooth connectivity to major highways, making commuting to other parts of Dubai hassle-free.

Supermarkets in Arjan Dubai

Arjan is well-served by several supermarkets, making grocery shopping convenient for residents. 

Popular options include Carrefour Market and Blue Mart, both within a 5-minute drive. Additionally, the nearby Al Barsha area, about 10 minutes away, offers larger hypermarkets like Lulu Hypermarket and Union Coop, providing a wide variety of grocery and household items.

Schools in Arjan Dubai

Arjan offers several educational options for families with young children. The neighborhood is home to nurseries like Wonder Years Nursery and Kids World Nursery, both of which are within a 5-minute drive.

For school-aged children, Safa Community School and Nord Anglia International School Dubai are approximately 10 minutes away, providing high-quality education following international curriculums. These institutions offer a supportive and enriching environment for children's academic and personal development.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Arjan

Arjan accommodates the spiritual needs of its diverse community with several places of worship nearby. The Al Salam Mosque is within a 10-minute drive, offering a place for daily prayers and religious gatherings for the Muslim community. 

For Christian residents, St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church and Christ Church Jebel Ali are about 20 minutes away. Hindu residents can visit the Gurunanak Darbar Sikh Temple, also located roughly 20 minutes from Arjan, providing a place for worship and community activities.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Arjan Dubai UAE

Healthcare services are readily accessible for residents of Arjan community Dubai. Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, a well-equipped facility offering a range of medical services, is just a 10-minute drive away. The nearby Al Zahra Hospital and Saudi German Hospital, both approximately 15 minutes from Arjan, provide comprehensive healthcare services, including emergency care, specialist consultations, and advanced medical treatments. 

Several clinics, such as Aster Clinic and HealthHub Clinic, are also located within a short drive, ensuring that residents have access to quality healthcare.

Arjan Location & Nearby Areas

Arjan is strategically located within Dubailand, providing easy access to major areas of Dubai. It is bordered by Al Barsha South to the north and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road to the south, facilitating smooth connectivity to other parts of the city. 

The vibrant Dubai Motor City, home to the Dubai Autodrome, is just a 10-minute drive away. Key destinations like Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, and Business Bay are within a 15-20 minute drive, making Arjan a conveniently situated community for both work and leisure. With its well-developed infrastructure and proximity to major attractions, Arjan offers a balanced and accessible lifestyle for its residents.

Arjan offers a variety of activities and attractions for residents and visitors. The community is renowned for housing the Dubai Miracle Garden, a stunning floral paradise featuring over 150 million flowers arranged in captivating designs.

Another popular attraction is the Dubai Butterfly Garden, where visitors can marvel at thousands of butterflies in a beautifully landscaped environment. For those who enjoy outdoor activities, Arjan's numerous parks and green spaces provide the perfect setting for picnics, jogging, and relaxation.

Shopping Malls in and Near Arjan Area

For shopping enthusiasts, several malls are easily accessible from Arjan. The Circle Mall in Jumeirah Village Circle is just a 5-minute drive away, offering a range of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment facilities. 

The larger Mall of the Emirates, located approximately 10 minutes away, features a vast array of shops, restaurants, and the renowned Ski Dubai. For more extensive shopping experiences, Dubai Mall and Ibn Battuta Mall are about 15-20 minutes away by car, providing even more options for retail therapy and leisure activities.

Restaurants in Arjan

Arjan boasts a diverse selection of dining options catering to various tastes and preferences. Residents can enjoy a range of cuisines, from casual eateries to fine dining restaurants. 

Popular options include Zest Restaurant, known for its international menu, and Socialicious, which offers a fusion of Asian and Western dishes. Additionally, the nearby areas of Jumeirah Village Circle and Al Barsha provide even more dining choices, ensuring that residents have access to a variety of culinary experiences.

Beaches Near Arjan

For beach enthusiasts, several beautiful beaches are within a short drive from Arjan. Jumeirah Beach, known for its pristine sands and clear waters, is approximately 20 minutes away. 

The vibrant Kite Beach, also about a 20-minute drive, offers a lively atmosphere with water sports, food trucks, and beachfront cafes. Further afield, the iconic La Mer beach is around 25 minutes away, featuring a mix of beach activities, dining, and shopping options in a trendy setting.

Hotels in Arjan

Arjan provides several accommodation options for visitors, including hotels and serviced apartments. Treppan Hotel & Suites by Fakhruddin offers comfortable stays with modern amenities, perfect for both short and long-term guests. 

Nearby, the FIVE Jumeirah Village Hotel provides luxury accommodations with stylish rooms, a range of dining options, and recreational facilities. For those seeking more options, the neighboring areas of Al Barsha and Dubai Marina offer a wide array of hotels catering to various budgets and preferences.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Arjan, Dubai

Arjan is strategically located near several notable attractions and landmarks. One of the most prominent is the Dubai Miracle Garden, renowned for its stunning floral displays and unique designs. Adjacent to it is the Dubai Butterfly Garden, where visitors can experience the beauty of thousands of butterflies in a serene environment.

Moreover, the vibrant Dubai Motor City, home to the Dubai Autodrome, is just a short drive away, offering thrilling motorsport events and activities. Other nearby landmarks include the Mall of the Emirates, with its extensive shopping, dining, and entertainment options, and the iconic Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, both within a 20-minute drive.

Outdoor Activities, Salons, and Gyms

Arjan offers a variety of outdoor activities for residents and visitors. The community features numerous parks and green spaces, perfect for jogging, picnicking, and family outings. For those who enjoy fitness and wellness, Arjan is home to several well-equipped gyms such as Fitness First and Snap Fitness, offering a range of classes and training options. 

Beauty and relaxation needs are catered to by a number of salons and spas, including Tips and Toes and The Haven Spa, providing services from haircuts and styling to massages and beauty treatments. Nearby areas like Jumeirah Village Circle and Al Barsha also offer additional options for outdoor activities, fitness, and beauty services, ensuring that residents have a comprehensive range of amenities to support a healthy and active lifestyle.

While the area is well-connected to major highways, providing easy access to other parts of Dubai, the nearest metro stations and extensive bus routes are not within immediate walking distance. But, they can easily take a taxi to reach the bus stops and metro stations within minutes.

Are there good schools and nurseries in Arjan?

Yes, Arjan is home to several reputable schools and nurseries. Notable options include Safa Community School and Nord Anglia International School Dubai, both of which are within a short driving distance. Additionally, there are nurseries like Wonder Years Nursery and Kids World Nursery, providing quality early education for young children.

What amenities are available in Arjan?

Arjan offers a range of amenities, including parks, gyms, retail outlets, and dining options. The community is known for attractions like Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden. Residents also have access to supermarkets, healthcare facilities, and fitness centers, ensuring a convenient and comfortable lifestyle.

How well is Arjan connected to other parts of Dubai?

Arjan is strategically located with easy access to major highways like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. This connectivity allows residents to reach key destinations such as Dubai Marina, Mall of the Emirates, and Business Bay within 15-20 minutes by car. However, public transportation options directly within Arjan are limited, making personal vehicles or taxis a more practical choice for commuting.

What is the cost of living in Arjan?

The cost of living in Arjan varies depending on the type of accommodation and lifestyle choices. Rental prices for apartments can range from AED 58,000 to AED 88,000 per year, while property prices for purchase vary widely. Overall, Arjan offers a range of housing options that can cater to different budgets, making it a viable choice for both middle-income and high-income residents.

data.content:
Arjan is a Dubailand district bordered by Al Barsha South to the north and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road to the south.

Arjan features apartment complexes, commercial buildings, and retail developments. The neighborhood is renowned for hosting two of Dubai's most popular parks, the Dubai Miracle Garden and the Dubai Butterfly Garden, making it a sought-after destination for leisure and recreation.

Launched in 2006, Arjan is a project by Dubai Properties Group. The fully developed road network ensures smooth connectivity within and outside the community.

nodes.title: Benessere
nodes.about:
Benessere is a project by developer Vincitore, which is a luxurious living space that promises the highest level of comfort and modern amenities for its residents. Here are cozy studios and apartments with 1-3 bedrooms.

The complex is located in one of the most convenient and accessible locations of the city, providing easy access to all key points: business centers, shopping malls, airports and cultural sites. Parks, sports facilities and educational institutions are located near the complex.

The architecture of the building is characterized by modern forms, elegance and attention to detail. Only high quality materials and innovative construction technologies are used to ensure the durability and attractiveness of the facilities.

Benessere offers a wide range of amenities that enhance the quality of life of its residents. The complex offers lobby and common areas, fitness center, outdoor and indoor swimming pools, spa and recreational facilities, recreation areas and green spaces and beautiful walking areas.

Benessere is the perfect place for those who appreciate high quality of life, modern design and first-class amenities. It combines elegance and functionality, providing its residents with everything they need for a comfortable and luxurious life in the center of the city.

nodes.title: Torino
nodes.about:
Torino is a luxury residential development located in the Arjan neighbourhood of Dubai. The project has been developed by Oro 24 Developments.

The complex consists of six 5-storey buildings with a large courtyard and includes studios and 1-2 bedroom apartments. The residences are designed to offer the maximum level of comfort to all residents. All units are partially furnished with fitted wardrobes and kitchen appliances.

The complex provides a wide range of facilities and services including: covered parking, badminton court, barbecue area, children's playground and swimming pool, gazebos, health club, jogging tracks, outdoor cinema, event space, petting zoo, squash court, swimming pool and water slide, yoga area, central air conditioning, 24-hour security and concierge services.

The complex is conveniently located in the centre of Dubai, in close proximity to two motorways and the popular Umm Suqeim road, making it quite easy to get around the city. The infrastructure of the neighbourhood is excellent, with several international educational institutions and hospitals, with many shops, pharmacies, cafes and restaurants within walking distance.

There are many popular attractions close to the complex, including: Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden, as well as Mall of the Emirates. Dubai International Airport is a 25-minute drive away.
